changelog_text:
## Changes

- Add the Tessera Crew Cabin for two kittens, with a pressurized interior, EVA exits, handholds and crewed control. It has a dry mass of about 1,367.5 kg, including a 905 kg polyethylene storm shelter liner.
- A full Crew Cabin carries about 7.13 kg of air, 25.62 kg of water and 27 meals. This is about four days of supplies for two kittens.
- Add the 14 kg Tessera Avionics Box for uncrewed control. It mounts on a deck station or panel face, draws 20 W from a 720 kJ battery and has a power switch and status light. Radiation tolerance is 300 Gy, upset dose is 270 mSv, and shielding is 1 g/cm2.
- Add the 2.5 kg Tessera Floodlight for surface lighting. It starts off, draws 40 W when on and tilts through 90 degrees.
- Set the Mizar gimbal slew limit to 8 degrees per second.
- Add side mounts to the Sphere Tank and Capsule Tank so they can also attach to a surface. Deck stations retain priority. The Thrust Cone and Core Column use stack placement, and the Hex and Oct Decks show more of their top faces in the picker.
- Existing part IDs and connector order stay the same. The new tank mounts follow the existing connectors.

## Compatibility

Validated against KSA build version **2026.11.16.5901**.

In game tests, Mosaic 1 with the Tessera Avionics Box landed from a 30 km lunar orbit.

## Installation

Extract into `Documents\My Games\Kitten Space Agency\mods\PurrlineTessera\`. No mod loader is needed.

listing.name: Tessera by Purrline Rocketworks
listing.abstract: A modular lunar lander kit: decks, wall and solar panels, a thrust cone, a core column, sphere, capsule and drum tanks, the Mizar descent engine, landing legs and a lattice ramp that deploy.
listing.description:
![A lander built from Tessera parts](ksa-image:hero)

**Tessera** is a modular lunar lander kit for Kitten Space Agency, from the fictional rocket maker **Purrline Rocketworks**. Build a robotic hopper, a cargo lander or a lander for two kittens from decks, panels, tanks, engines and legs that snap together at their edges.

## Parts

The kit has 21 editor entries.

- **Tessera Hex Deck** and **Oct Deck**: the floors of a lander, with seats for tanks and engines and six or eight edges for panels; open or closed.
- **Tessera Wall Panel**, **Half Panel** and **Taper Panel**: walls and skirts in isogrid, skin, radiator, gold foil and silver foil looks; wall and half panels have leg pads at their lower corners.
- **Tessera Solar Wall Panel** and **Solar Half Panel**: walls of solar cells, 420 W and 210 W.
- **Tessera Thrust Cone**, **Core Column** and **Deck Strut**: the structure under and between the decks.
- **Tessera Sphere Tank**, **Capsule Tank** and **Drum Tank**: Methalox tanks in bare, gold blanket and silver blanket looks; the sphere also as a carbon bottle.
- **Mizar** and **Mizar Fixed**: the descent engine, 3.1 kN, with a gimbal or on a fixed mount.
- **Tessera Landing Leg** in a short and a long form, and the **Tessera Lattice Ramp**: they deploy from the part menu.
- **Tessera Avionics Box**: uncrewed control with a battery, a power switch and radiation protection.
- **Tessera Floodlight**: surface-mounted light with a switch and a 90-degree tilt range.
- **Tessera Crew Cabin**: two seats, an interior, EVA exits and radiation shielding.

Press V to change the variant of a part that has more than one look. Use the Avionics Box for an uncrewed build or assign crew to the cabin. The tanks hold the true volume of their shape, so a stock tank of the same size holds about four times as much.

![Original parts and looks](ksa-image:all-parts)

![A tall hex lander](ksa-image:tall-lander)

![A wide octagonal cargo lander](ksa-image:wide-lander)

![Seven Mizar Fixed in a Thrust Cone, from below](ksa-image:engines-below)

The landers in the pictures were built in the editor from these parts; the mod contains no vehicle files. Some of them carry payload parts of Facet by Purrline Rocketworks.

## Requirements

No other mod needed.

## Install

- Borea: install Tessera from the content list.
- By hand: copy `PurrlineTessera` from the release zip into `Documents/My Games/Kitten Space Agency/mods/` and enable it.

To remove the mod, delete its folder. Vehicles with its parts do not load without it.

Made for KSA build 2026.11.16.5901.
